lede: Savage keeps its holiday kickoff short and warm, with a City Hall tree lighting, cocoa and a bonfire.
celebrates: The City of Savage kicks off its holiday season with the Tree Lighting Ceremony at City Hall on Thursday, December 3. The ceremony runs from 5:30 to 6 pm, so it works for an early evening with young kids.
